name: underdetermined
source:
{ One equation, two unknowns - must fail with a degrees-of-freedom error. }
m + n = 5

error.message: There are 1 equations and 2 variables. The problem is underspecified and cannot be solved. Free quantity (no defining relation): n. Coupled to: m. A common cause: an element chain with no constitutive law for that quantity — e.g. an efficiency-only machine or rigid pass-through between boundaries leaves its through-flow or a port pressure free; add an orifice/valve/flow-map element or pin a boundary value.
